regions.merged_text: With love and with Christmas greetings to all Comes the Infant once more to free us from sorrow Whose smile and Whose power and Whose gentleness call To each heart and each soul for a Manger Tomorrow; Whose love and whose goodness -- Whose wonders proclaim Him, the Son of the Virgin, as Promised of yore. - may He estrange us from sin and its shame! - 0! And reign in our Heart, as His crib evermore!
